kanzAlMahalliRecords.scope: Full and consanguine brother's sons, full and consanguine paternal uncles, their sons, priority, and residue entitlement.
Direct male/female emancipator follows all nasab residuaries.

khulasaRecord.scope: The male-blocker table enumerates each nearer class, and the distribution paragraph gives the same complete finite priority order through the emancipator.

shortParaphrase: After the nearer descendants, ascendants, and sibling residuaries, the first eligible named brother's-son/uncle class receives residue; direct wala' follows all nasab residuaries.
conditions: The heir is one of the exact relationship categories already represented by the UI/domain model.
All source-prioritized nearer residuaries are absent or actually blocked.
Members of the same modeled male category share its collective residue equally.
exclusions: No unmodeled farther agnate, lineage depth, emancipator's agnate, or multiple-emancipator branch is inferred.
A fixed-share heir is not treated as a blocker unless that heir is actually residuary in the selected case.
blockingAndPriorityInteractions: Full brother's son precedes consanguine brother's son.
Consanguine brother's son precedes full paternal uncle.
Full paternal uncle precedes consanguine paternal uncle.
Consanguine paternal uncle precedes full paternal uncle's son.
Full paternal uncle's son precedes consanguine paternal uncle's son.
Every eligible nasab residuary precedes direct wala'.

sourceAgreement.detail: The two Shafi'i sources give the same finite priority sequence and nasab-before-wala' rule for the modeled categories.
